## About
PS Auto Body is an auto body shop on W Baker Ave in Englewood. We handle collision repair, frame repair, full service paint, paintless dent and hail repair, and custom refinishing. There is no job too big for us.
We use state-of-the-art technology and keep our focus on quality workmanship and good customer service. Estimates are by appointment only, so call ahead and we'll find a time that works.
We're rated 5 on Google from 87 reviews.

## Services
- Collision repair: Repairs after an accident, starting with a collision repair estimate by appointment.
- Full service paint: Paint work for your vehicle, done in our shop.
- Paintless dent and hail repair: Dent and hail damage repair without repainting.
- Frame repair: Full service frame repair.
- Custom autobody refinishing: Custom refinishing work for your vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: Do I need an appointment for an estimate?
A: Yes. Estimates are by appointment only, so please call us to schedule a time.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: No. We're closed Saturday and Sunday.
